description: `step.steer` queues a message (and/or a route/effort change) for a RUNNING step, injected at the next turn boundary (LW1) — never mid-stream. Keyed by stepId, never by loop (D12/P33). At least one of text/route/reasoningEffort is required; refusal on a step that is not running names the state and the method to use instead (LW4).
